submitted.rationale: Of the three compositions measured, index 16 (Sb 0.66, the ZnSb2O6 stoichiometry) gave the highest EQE (9.8e-4 %). The Zn-rich side (index 4) was about half that. At high Sb (index 25) the EQE was negative, which is effectively no photoresponse. XRD showed the same main peaks across the whole line and matched none of the database phases well, so it could not separate the compositions.
